mapper.sql: v.surplus_fund_guide_version_id, v.user_id, v.guide_version_no, v.guide_name, v.surplus_fund_calculation_id, v.surplus_fund_plan_id, v.selected_etf_count, v.snapshot_schema_version, v.idempotency_key, v.completed_at, v.name_updated_at, v.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT surplus_fund_calculation_id, user_id, total_current_balance, selected_account_balance, estimated_next_income_date, adjusted_next_income_date, estimated_living_expense, adjusted_living_expense, estimated_scheduled_expense, adjusted_scheduled_expense, recommended_emergency_fund, adjusted_emergency_fund, calculated_surplus_amount, final_surplus_amount FROM surplus_fund_calculation WHERE surplus_fund_calculation_id = #{calculationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT surplus_fund_plan_id, user_id, operation_amount, investment_style, rule_version, confirmed_at FROM surplus_fund_plan WHERE surplus_fund_plan_id = #{planId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT asset_type, allocation_ratio, allocation_amount FROM surplus_fund_plan_allocation WHERE surplus_fund_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY FIELD(asset_type, 'CASH', 'ETF', 'FUND')
SELECT reason_order, reason_text FROM surplus_fund_plan_reason WHERE surplus_fund_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY reason_order

SELECT NULL AS surplus_fund_guide_etf_snapshot_id, NULL AS surplus_fund_guide_version_id, c.investment_product_id AS source_investment_product_id, 0 AS selection_order, c.product_code, c.isin_code, c.product_name, c.provider_name, c.category, c.source_type, d.price_base_date, d.closing_price, d.previous_day_change, d.fluctuation_rate, d.nav, d.opening_price, d.high_price, d.low_price, d.trading_volume, d.trading_value, d.listed_share_count, d.market_cap, d.net_asset_total_amount, d.base_index_name, d.base_index_close, c.last_synced_at AS product_last_synced_at, NULL AS captured_at FROM investment_product_catalog c INNER JOIN etf_product_detail d ON d.investment_product_id = c.investment_product_id WHERE c.product_type = 'ETF' AND c.active = 1 AND c.investment_product_id IN
#{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO surplus_fund_guide_version ( user_id, guide_version_no, guide_name, surplus_fund_calculation_id, surplus_fund_plan_id, selected_etf_count, snapshot_schema_version, idempotency_key, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{guideVersionNo}, #{guideName}, #{surplusFundCalculationId}, #{surplusFundPlanId}, #{selectedEtfCount}, #{snapshotSchemaVersion}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{completedAt} )

INSERT INTO surplus_fund_guide_etf_snapshot ( surplus_fund_guide_version_id, source_investment_product_id, selection_order, product_code, isin_code, product_name, provider_name, category, source_type, price_base_date, closing_price, previous_day_change, fluctuation_rate, nav, opening_price, high_price, low_price, trading_volume, trading_value, listed_share_count, market_cap, net_asset_total_amount, base_index_name, base_index_close, product_last_synced_at, captured_at ) VALUES
( #{guideVersionId}, #{snapshot.sourceInvestmentProductId}, #{snapshot.selectionOrder}, #{snapshot.productCode}, #{snapshot.isinCode}, #{snapshot.productName}, #{snapshot.providerName}, #{snapshot.category}, #{snapshot.sourceType}, #{snapshot.priceBaseDate}, #{snapshot.closingPrice}, #{snapshot.previousDayChange}, #{snapshot.fluctuationRate}, #{snapshot.nav}, #{snapshot.openingPrice}, #{snapshot.highPrice}, #{snapshot.lowPrice}, #{snapshot.tradingVolume}, #{snapshot.tradingValue}, #{snapshot.listedShareCount}, #{snapshot.marketCap}, #{snapshot.netAssetTotalAmount}, #{snapshot.baseIndexName}, #{snapshot.baseIndexClose}, #{snapshot.productLastSyncedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT , p.operation_amount, p.investment_style FROM surplus_fund_guide_version v INNER JOIN surplus_fund_plan p ON p.surplus_fund_plan_id = v.surplus_fund_plan_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY v.guide_version_no DESC

SELECT surplus_fund_guide_etf_snapshot_id, surplus_fund_guide_version_id, source_investment_product_id, selection_order, product_code, isin_code, product_name, provider_name, category, source_type, price_base_date, closing_price, previous_day_change, fluctuation_rate, nav, opening_price, high_price, low_price, trading_volume, trading_value, listed_share_count, market_cap, net_asset_total_amount, base_index_name, base_index_close, product_last_synced_at, captured_at FROM surplus_fund_guide_etf_snapshot WHERE surplus_fund_guide_version_id = #{guideVersionId} ORDER BY selection_order
